TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
1312 W. North Avenue

The Applicant seeks to rezone 1312 W. North Avenue from a M3-3 Heavy Industry District to a
C3-3 Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District in order to convert vacant
commercial building into entertainment venue. Currently, the subject property is improved with
a vacant two-story commercial building with a 2,905 square foot building footprint and eight (8)
parking spaces. The Applicant seeks to convert the existing commercial building to an
entertainment venue (medium) with approximately 6,060 square feet of commercial space. The
footprint and height of the existing building will remain unchanged.
